settings.target_source: E240's common update size (experiments/kstar_vpd_norm_matched/results/predictions.json settings.target): new_thin's, the smallest of the six, so every built edit is scaled by c <= 1 toward M (E240.scale_factors, unchanged)
settings.built_source: E226's six known-answer items in E240's order of cost: the four reuse items on 75 copy24 windows first, then the two new items on 512 cue windows
settings.window_sets_source: the two window sets the six items are read on (E226 World.make): copy = E195's copy24 held-out windows, every position (x2, x10, moved, rebuilt); cue = E214's cue windows, last position (new_few, new_thin); the do-nothing and the random updates are read on both
settings.split_seed_source: E226's and E228's seed for the two halves of D
settings.random_seeds_source: three Gaussian directions per window set, E228's n = 3 (card n per arm)
settings.match_source: E46 Amendment 1's and E228's matcher (commute.perturb.match) with their filed scale_cap 100 and kl_rel_tol 0.1
settings.kl_target_floors_source: the KL-matched random arm is scaled until KL(F||M) = 2 f on its window set, f the floor this job's stage 0 measures there: the smallest output size at which a perfect gate refit could reach S = 1/2 (S = 1 - KL(F||H)/KL(F||M) >= 1 - f/KL(F||M) only if H is no better than M's own reconstruction), so the arm is scored by construction while the size-matched arm may fall under the floor

thresholds.thresholds_source: kl_floor: E214's filed value (KL(F||M) at the do-nothing; E232 read 0 exactly on its scaling path). gate_path_tol: this run computes Gamma's gates from the inputs captured in each network's own forward under bf16 autocast (so a changed model with appended neurons can be read); vpd.compute_ci runs the same forward inside the component model; at M the two must agree to bf16 resolution, unit roundoff 2^-8 = 0.0039 near 1, and 0.01 is about 2.5 ulps: a wrong input key or dtype path moves gates by O(0.1-1). open_rel: M's pieces with every gate at 1 and Delta at mask 1 are M's weights to fp32 rounding (Delta = W0 - UV^T), so KL(M || H_open) is rounding only; it must sit 1000x under the floor f it is read beside, so it cannot move S by more than 1e-3 f / KL(F||M). size_rel: E240's filed value (dW_c rounded to fp32 once per entry, a wrong c is off by >= 1e-2). kl_repro_rel: E232's filed value for KL(F||M) against a saved reading of the same state (E232 matched E205 to 1e-7 relative).

definitions.H: M's released VPD pieces (every subcomponent's U, V; Delta out), CI-masked with Gamma's gates (lower_leaky, continuous) computed by frozen Gamma from F's own activations on the same window: the re-gating construction L01 (GOALS.md route split (b); masked_reads.route_cells_by K01), with the masked forward in fp32
definitions.cells: per window, KL over the whole vocabulary averaged over the item's read positions (rule_retention.kl, fp64): kl_fm = KL(F||M); K01 = KL(F||H); K00 = KL(F||H_M), H_M = M's pieces at M's own gates; f = KL(M||H_M), VPD's own reconstruction floor on those windows
definitions.S: 1 - mean K01 / mean kl_fm over the item's windows (the user's score, ratio of means)
definitions.S00: 1 - mean K00 / mean kl_fm: S with the gates left at M's (what the refit adds is S - S00)
definitions.S_c: 1 - (mean K01 - mean f) / mean kl_fm: S with VPD's own floor taken off (lead's side reading, not the user's score)
definitions.scored: for S: mean kl_fm > mean f on the item's windows (below it S <= 0 for any gate refit no better than VPD reconstructs M); for S_c, which takes f off: mean kl_fm > kl_floor ('scored_c'). An item not read on a score reports its numbers but enters none of that score's rules
definitions.band: per score (S, S_c): max over the six built items read on that score of |score(half 1) - score(half 2)|, halves of each item's windows by split_seed (E239's and E240's band: the built items only, so a random reading of tiny KL(F||M) cannot inflate it); degenerate (no item or every difference 0): 0, the rules then strict orders, reported as degenerate

R0 (stops).rule: exit 1 on a miss. Stage 0, first and alone in each job, per window set (built job: copy and cue, F = E240.scaled(M, F_item, 0); pairs job: E232's do_nothing_c0): mean kl_fm <= kl_floor; F's gates equal M's exactly on every window; |mean K01 - mean f| <= kl_floor; f > 0 and finite; max |gates by capture - vpd.compute_ci gates| at M <= gate_path_tol; mean KL(M || H_open) <= open_rel x f. Per built item: |sum over the 24 matrices of |F_c - M|^2 / new_thin's E226 dW2 - 1| <= size_rel; per random size draw the same against the same target. Per item with a saved KL(F||M) (new_thin at c = 1, every pair state): |kl_fm / saved - 1| <= kl_repro_rel.
R0 (stops).expected: do-nothing: kl_fm 0, gates equal, K01 = K00 = f, S not scored; f about 0.4 nats per position (E228 read K0 0.42-0.46 on 67M rows, experiments/random_kl_share/results/states/*.json .own.K.K0); open about 1e-10
R0 (stops).absolute_or_relative: absolute, except size_rel, open_rel and kl_repro_rel
R0 (stops).blind_to: whether S means reuse; they check the scaling path, the gate path and the masked forward
R0 (stops).positive_control: H_open = M (every gate open, Delta in) and H = H_M at F = M
